gloss: rate of progress; pace of advancement

definitions.gloss: rate of progress; pace of advancement; degree of progress
definitions.explanation: The speed or degree to which work, study, or a project has advanced. Commonly used in educational and business contexts to measure how far along something is.

examples.japanese: ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進度|しんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: The pace of the class is fast.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進度|しんど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the progress of the construction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進度|しんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{転校|てんこう}する→転校する：25400_tenkousuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{戸惑|とまど}う→戸惑う：06036_tomadou⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Since the pace of the textbook differs between schools, transferring can be confusing.

notes:
Compound of {進|しん} (advance) and ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (degree). Focuses on the rate or extent of advancement, particularly in structured contexts like education, construction, or project management.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進度|しんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧: the progress is fast
- {進度|しんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧: the progress is slow
- {進度|しんど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧: to match the pace
- {進度|しんど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the progress
- ⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧{進度|しんど}: learning progress/pace

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{進捗|しんちょく}→進捗：07377_shinchoku⟧: progress — more formal, used in business for project status updates
- ⟦{進行|しんこう}→進行：03686_shinkou⟧: progression, advance — the act of moving forward, broader usage
- ⟦ペース→ペース：11173_peesu⟧: pace — loanword used casually for speed of progress
